name: Wasting
overview: Scripture warns against wasting both resources and time, emphasizing diligence and wise stewardship. The commands in Leviticus 19:9 to leave portions of the harvest reflect God's provision and caution against complete depletion, while Proverbs highlights the dangers of slothfulness and loving sleep, which can lead to poverty. Psalms 90:12 calls believers to wisely number their days, applying their hearts to wisdom, and the parable in Matthew 25:14 underscores the responsibility to faithfully manage what the Lord entrusts. Together, these verses teach that wasting money or time is contrary to a Christ-centered life of faithful stewardship and purposeful living.
